title: Block Code of a DNF Term
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ variables whose width is at most $w$, let $P$ be a set of positions in $T$, and let $x$ be a binary assignment to the variables. The block code has as its positions the images of the elements of $P$ among the $w$ positions, and at each such position its bit is the relative bit of $x$ at the corresponding literal.
hypotheses_covered: The width of $T$ is at most $w$

A binary assignment to the $n$ variables
